'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A plane carrying four people crashes in [[Sioux Lookout]], [[Ontario]], Canada, killing everyone on board. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/four-dead-plane-crash-sioux-lookout-1.6437527 (CBC)]

[https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-61281692 (BBC News)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2022/05/01/three-meteorology-students-die-kansas-tornado-chasing/9606752002/ (''USA Today'')]
